description: Build your own word search puzzle — enter custom words and hunt them in a real 8-direction letter grid.

faqs.a: Up to 20 words, each 3–15 letters long. Words that don't fit are listed so you can shorten them.
faqs.q: How many words can I add?

faqs.a: All 8 directions: horizontal, vertical, and diagonal — forwards and backwards.
faqs.q: Which directions are words hidden in?

faqs.a: Tap the first letter, then tap the last letter. On desktop you can also click and drag.
faqs.q: How do I select a word on mobile?

faqs.a: Find every word in the word list — found words get crossed off automatically.

howto: Type your words, one per line or comma-separated.
Pick a grid size and press Generate puzzle.
Click-drag (or tap start, then tap end) to select a word.
Find every word in the list to win.
title: Word Search Generator
